blurb_zh: 一年里人数怎么从 120 涨到 150
scene_zh: 一家成长中公司的全年人员变动（模拟数据）

views.subject: Team headcount
views.subtitle_en: How the team grew from January to December.

examples.en: Hiring added 44 people, the largest single step of the year.
examples.zh: 招聘带来 44 人，是全年最大的一步。

features.note_zh: largest single step 指单项最大，不把招聘批次合在一起算。
features.interpret_zh: 招聘是总流入，之后还要扣除离职和合同到期。

examples.en: Attrition took 21 people off the payroll.
examples.zh: 离职让在职人数少了 21 人。

features.note_zh: take ... off the payroll 是人力语境里的口语表达。
features.interpret_zh: 离职抵消了招聘的近一半，净增长因此只有 30 人。

examples.en: The reorganization brought 9 people into the team.
examples.zh: 组织调整给团队转入了 9 人。

features.note_zh: bring ... into 说人员转入；转出用 move out。
features.interpret_zh: 同一次调整还转出 6 人，净增加只有 3 人。

examples.en: Contract conversions added 12 people to the permanent headcount.
examples.zh: 合同转正让正式员工增加 12 人。

features.note_zh: conversion 指合同工转正式，不是新招人。
features.interpret_zh: 这 12 人不是新增劳动力，只是身份变化。

examples.en: Eight interns left when their contracts ended.
examples.zh: 八名实习生合同到期离开。

features.note_zh: left when their contracts ended 说明离开原因。
features.interpret_zh: 实习生离开是季节性的，年底常见。

examples.en: Headcount grew from 120 in January to 150 in December, a net gain of 30.
examples.zh: 人数从一月的 120 人增至十二月的 150 人，净增 30 人。

features.note_zh: net gain 是扣除所有流出后的结果。
features.interpret_zh: 净增 25%，但内部流入流出合计远超 30 人。

views.overview_zh: 全年人数从 120 增至 150，净增 30 人。招聘 44 人是最大流入，离职 21 人和实习生到期 8 人抵消大半；组织调整净转入 3 人。

general.a2: The team grew from 120 people in January to 150 in December. Hiring added 44 people, and attrition removed 21. Other changes made up the rest of the growth.
general.b1: Headcount rose from 120 to 150 over the year, a net gain of 30. Hiring was the biggest driver at 44 people, partly offset by 21 departures. Contract conversions added 12, while eight interns left when their contracts ended.
general.b2: The team ended the year at 150, up 30 from January's 120. Gross hiring of 44 was the largest single step, but attrition of 21 and eight interns ending their contracts absorbed much of it. A reorganization and 12 contract conversions completed the net gain.

descriptions.ielts: Team headcount increased from 120 in January to 150 in December. Hiring contributed 44 people, the largest increase, while attrition reduced the total by 21. Contract conversions added a further 12, and eight interns left at the end of their contracts.
descriptions.business: Net headcount growth was 30 people, but gross hiring reached 44. Attrition of 21 and eight interns leaving are the retention signals to watch; the reorganization was roughly neutral at plus three overall.

views.subject: Share of headcount by function
views.subtitle_en: How the function mix shifted from 2024 to 2026.

examples.en: Product rose from 10 percent to 16 percent and moved from fourth to third.
examples.zh: 产品从 10% 升到 16%，名次从第四升到第三。

features.note_zh: rank_up 描述名次；数值变化另用 rose from ... to ...。
features.interpret_zh: 产品超过运营，但距离第二的销售还有 2 个百分点。

examples.en: Operations fell from 12 percent to 8 percent, dropping from third to fifth.
examples.zh: 运营从 12% 降到 8%，名次从第三跌到第五。

features.note_zh: drop from ... to ... 可同时说数值和名次，注意上下文。
features.interpret_zh: 运营是唯一占比明显收缩的职能。

examples.en: Engineering is still the largest function at 44 percent, down from 50.
examples.zh: 工程仍是最大职能，占 44%，低于此前的 50%。

features.note_zh: 名次不变用 remain + 名次；数值下降另说。
features.interpret_zh: 名次没变不代表规模不变，占比掉了 6 个百分点。

examples.en: Customer success grew from 8 to 14 percent and passed operations.
examples.zh: 客户成功从 8% 增至 14%，超过了运营。

features.note_zh: pass 是口语里最自然的反超动词。
features.interpret_zh: 客户成功从最小职能升到第四。

examples.en: In 2026, product made up 16 percent of headcount.

features.note_zh: make up + 百分比 描述构成。
features.interpret_zh: 单看一个年份只能说明结构，不能说明人数。

examples.en: Sales held second place but shrank from 20 to 18 percent.
examples.zh: 销售保住第二，但占比从 20% 降到 18%。

features.note_zh: hold + 名次 说名次不变，常暗示有压力。
features.interpret_zh: 占比下降而名次不变，是因为后面的职能基数更小。

views.overview_zh: 工程师仍是最大职能，但占比从 50% 降到 44%；产品从 10% 升到 16%，客户成功从 8% 升到 14%；运营从第三跌到第五。整体在向产品和客户侧倾斜。

general.a2: Engineers are still the biggest group, but their share fell from 50 to 44 percent. Product and customer success grew. Operations became a smaller part of the team.
general.b1: Engineering's share of headcount fell from 50 to 44 percent, though it remains the largest function. Product grew from 10 to 16 percent and customer success from 8 to 14, while operations dropped from 12 to 8.
general.b2: The function mix shifted toward product and customer success. Engineering remains the largest group at 44 percent, down six points, while product gained six and customer success six. Operations lost four points and fell from third to fifth place.

descriptions.ielts: Engineering remained the largest function in 2026 at 44 percent, down from 50 percent in 2024. Product rose from 10 to 16 percent, and customer success from 8 to 14, while operations fell from 12 to 8 percent.
descriptions.business: The mix moved toward product and customer-facing roles. Engineering is still the anchor at 44 percent, but the six-point decline and the rise of product and customer success suggest a deliberate shift from build to serve.
